parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border screening or police targeting is documented, and parent law prohibits gender-identity discrimination and aggravates transphobic crimes. The operative traveler exposure is custody: trans women recorded as male are held in all-male establishments, and the 2021 national preventive mechanism, extending 2010 findings, reports persistent serious violations concerning about 40 detainees since 2010 without a documented working remedy. Small, isolated, religiously conservative social context with stigma alongside recognised gender-variant roles, and no local specialist care, adds friction but no other universal exposure is documented. This is unremedied birth-sex custody exposure in the Elevated Risk band.

entry_documents.protection: Parent law does not criminalise trans visitors; no local override identified.
entry_documents.interaction: No entry, airport or document-check practice for trans visitors is documented, so no interaction can be rated.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Trans women whose legal gender is recorded as male, largely pre-surgery, are held in all-male establishments; 2021 preventive mechanism reports persistent serious violations in detention.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Transphobia is an aggravating circumstance for crimes since 2017, but no documented remedy has changed custody placement.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any visitor detained for an unrelated reason faces the same legal-sex placement; recurring oversight findings corroborate, rather than mitigate, the exposure.

federal_state_facilities.protection: No birth-sex bathroom or public-facility restriction documented; discrimination in access to services prohibited since 2012 at parent level.

care_services.exposure: Access to gender-affirming healthcare is uneven nationally; no local specialists and residents travel outward.
care_services.protection: Gender-affirming surgery lawful since 1979 and funded via long-term illness classification nationally.
care_services.interaction: Visitor emergency care, ward placement and medication continuity are not documented; resident specialist shortage may affect emergency referral but is not documented as a visitor rule.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No criminalisation of trans people or same-sex relations; discrimination prohibited since 2012; conversion therapy banned 2022.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Resident marker-change court process and absence of non-binary status do not govern a visitor's home passport and are not traveler exposures.

minors_guardians.protection: No enacted ban on under-18 medical transition documented; 2024 upper-house bill is stalled since July 2024.
minors_guardians.interaction: Application of the stalled bill to this collectivity and to visiting families is unresolved; no documented visitor-facing restriction.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Local hate-crime statistics are not sourced; national figures are raw counts without denominators.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Transphobia as aggravating circumstance since 2017 is a documented legal protection, with local enforcement not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Isolation, religious norms and stigma coexisting with recognised gender-variant roles suggest social friction, but no documented targeting pattern.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Detention oversight has recorded the same serious violations from 2010 to 2021 without documented correction.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Working local remedies for service refusal, violence or custody placement are not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of documented remedies for the documented custody exposure prevents a higher rating; other unknowns are not treated as safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Very similar: no presentation offence or facility ban, but binding birth-sex custody placement with repeatedly documented humiliation and no effective change, rated 0.45. This dossier matches that custody-centred profile.

Lower than this case: that anchor adds birth-sex hospital placement and repeated sexual harassment in wards on top of detention, plus no effective remedy. No equivalent hospital-ward rule is documented here, so it sits above 0.35.

Higher than this case: that anchor has no universal exclusion, individual detention assessment, and documented refunds, training and convictions showing remedies work. Here custody remedy is documented as not working, so it sits materially below 0.65.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: permissive parent criminal and anti-discrimination law with no documented border, facility or street-targeting exposure, but a single tier-1 traveler-facing practice - legal-sex custody placement with persistent serious violations and no demonstrated correction - governs the rating. Social stigma and lack of local specialist care are secondary friction. Unknowns on entry, facilities and emergency care are not credited as safety, while resident-only marker and care rules do not offset or add traveler exposure. Hence Elevated Risk, centred on custody.
